description: This file defines the HTMLPurifier_URI class, which represents an internal data structure for a URI within the HTML Purifier library. It includes properties for various URI components such as scheme, host, port, path, query, and fragment, and methods for validation, normalization, and output of the URI.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URI
classes.description: Class representing a URI in HTML Purifier, capable of validating and reconstructing URIs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes URI components, normalizing the scheme to lowercase if not null.

methods.name: getSchemeObj
methods.description: Retrieves an appropriate scheme object based on the URI's scheme, configuration, and context.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation and normalization of URI components according to RFC 3986, encoding where necessary.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Reconstructs and returns the URI as a string.

methods.name: isLocal
methods.description: Determines if the URI is considered 'local' based on its host and current configuration.

methods.name: isBenign
methods.description: Determines if the URI is considered 'benign' based on locality and security level.
